summary: Deep analysis of nf_exist_formula_nested_backward confirms formula is mathematically insufficient. The formula fires for nf_x values whose actual 2-var NF at (x,t) differs from sub_nf in the quantifier part. The filter (nf_full_compat_right) passes true for all atom-compatible non-interval ssns regardless of sub_nf.2. Fixing requires modifying the formula to encode negative interval conditions (guard), non-interval quantifier checks (filter + event), and y < t zone conditions (pre-condition at t). Full zone analysis written to handoff.

blockers: nf_exist_formula_nested is mathematically insufficient for the backward direction: it does not encode (1) negative interval conditions in the guard, (2) non-interval quantifier agreement in the filter/event, (3) y < t zone conditions. Formula modification required before backward proof can proceed.

At k >= 1, even with formula modifications for k=0, the guard approach is insufficient because the depth-k 3-var NF is not determined by 1-var NF types. Full Rabinovich Section 5 encoding or generalized mutual induction with P2(k,n) for all arities n would be needed.
